title: Grateful Dead Live at Roscoe Maples Pavilion - Stanford University on 1973-02-09
source: MR 2 Track Reel > 7.5 IPS 1/4 tack dolby B reel > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CDR

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a high‑energy show with an epic, long Eyes of the World; audio is generally good but has noticeable dead space between songs.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this performance, highlighting a sprawling and intricate version of “Eyes of the World” that showcases the band at a peak. The soundboard source delivers clear and balanced sound overall, though several reviewers note excessive silence after each track. Energy is high throughout, making it a favorite among listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with standout long jams and high energy; soundboard recording is solid but has minor dead‑space issues, leading to a slightly lower technical score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and balanced soundboard mix, but reviewers mention noticeable dead space (silence) after every song, suggesting gaps in the recording or indexing.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Extended, intricate performances flow smoothly despite the post‑song gaps, maintaining a strong momentum especially during the long Eyes of the World.
